# exo_external_in_outlook (Resource)

Manages the ExternalInOutlook configuration via Set-ExternalInOutlook.

## Schema

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `allow_list` (String) Maps to the -AllowList parameter.
- `enabled` (String) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
